## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin ganz in meinem Element.** — [ish bin gants in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm totally in my element.*
2. **Das lässt mich nicht los.** — [dahs lesst mish nisht LOHS] — *I can't stop thinking about it.*
3. **Mir fällt gerade ein...** — [meer felt geh-RAH-duh ine] — *It just occurred to me...*
